brief.aim: Predict the HER2 status of breast tumours in CPTAC-BRCA from mass-spectrometry protein abundance. Compare several classifiers with cross-validation on the training rows, and report discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analysis for the selected model. Positive cases are rare, so use precision-recall AUC as the primary metric.
brief.repeated_subjects: None declared; sample_id is unique per row, so no subject-level repetition is expected
brief.unit: One breast tumour sample (one mass-spectrometry proteome run) from a single patient
